body:
### Summary

`uv build --all-packages` on a large workspace (54 members, all `hatchling` + `hatch-vcs`) intermittently hangs forever when the cache is cold (`UV_NO_CACHE=1`, or a fresh `UV_CACHE_DIR`). uv never spawns a build backend, and the 5-minute `UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT` default does not fire. In CI the hang lasts until the 6h job timeout.

### Observations (uv 0.12.23, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

- All 54 `[pkg] Building source distribution...` lines print, then nothing. The `uv` process has **0 child processes**.
- `-v` logs 530 `INFO Waiting to acquire exclusive lock for .../wheels-v6/pypi/<build-req>/<version>-py3-none-any.lock` lines within the same second. They cover the ~10 shared build requirements (hatchling, hatch-vcs, setuptools-scm, vcs-versioning, packaging, pathspec, pluggy, trove-classifiers, setuptools, tomlkit), ~53 waiters each.
- The process sits at **514 threads**, with ~541 open `.lock` fds and 11 flocks held by the same pid (`/proc/locks`). These numbers don't change for more than 6 minutes, and no lock-timeout error is ever printed.

### Likely mechanism

`LockedFile::lock_file` (`crates/uv-fs/src/locked_file.rs`) waits for a contended lock with `tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || mode.lock(&file))`, which is a blocking `flock` on the blocking pool (default cap 512). `lock_wheel` (`crates/uv-distribution/src/distribution_database.rs`) holds the wheel-cache lock across download and extraction, and extraction also runs on the blocking pool. Once the waiters (54 builds × ~10 shared build requirements ≈ 540) occupy all 512 blocking threads, the lock holders' extraction work is queued behind them and never runs, so the locks are never released.

The `tokio::time::timeout(*LOCK_TIMEOUT, …)` around the waiter also doesn't seem to rescue this. A waiter that times out still leaves its blocking thread parked in `flock`, and the holders (which have no timeout) keep the overall build pending.

### Reproduction sketch

1. A workspace with ~50+ members, each with `[build-system] requires = ["hatchling", "hatch-vcs"]`.
2. `UV_NO_CACHE=1 uv build --all-packages --out-dir dist/`

The hang is timing-dependent: a few percent of runs on a 4-vCPU CI runner, and nearly every run on a heavily loaded 4-core host.

### Workaround

Building members in separate processes with bounded parallelism (`uv workspace list --paths | xargs -P4 -I{} uv build {} --out-dir dist/`, sharing one cache) avoids the hang.

### Suggestions

- Wait for contended locks without parking a blocking-pool thread per waiter, for example by polling `try_lock` with backoff, or by deduplicating in-process waiters on the same path with an async mutex before taking the flock.
- And/or bound concurrent build-environment setup so that waiters can't exceed the blocking pool.
title: `uv build --all-packages` deadlocks with a cold cache: wheel-lock waiters exhaust the tokio blocking pool
